# Astronomical 0.2.87
## What changed
- **Faster long-prompt prefill for SSD-streamed models.** The default prefill chunk is now 4,096 tokens (was 2,048). A paired A/B on the largest sparse model measured 13–21% faster prefill in 12 of 12 pairings. A configuration that still holds the old default is migrated; values you set explicitly are kept. - **Back-to-back long requests no longer fail near the memory ceiling.** A second long request on the largest sparse model could be rejected with "configured prefill chunk exceeded the MLX active-memory limit". Memory recovery now keeps expert residency released until decode, so the retry streams and succeeds at the same chunk size. - **OptiQ and oQ models are told apart.** OptiQ's per-layer metadata is validated against the model configuration at load, oQ/oQe models are recognized on their own, and the Library labels an oQ model as oQ.
## Compatibility
There are no REST or configuration-format changes. Your models, settings, and caches are preserved.
## Distribution
This release is signed with a Developer ID certificate, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed Sparkle update feed.
